offer.title: BYPCMS purchase and license terms
offer.lead: Public offer for a simple, non-exclusive BYPCMS license and the procedure for ordering custom services.

sections.title: 1. Parties and subject
paragraphs: BYPCMS service provider and rights holder: Yury Petrovich Babachkov, Tax ID (INN) 550519989590, a professional income taxpayer without individual entrepreneur status. Contact: hello@bypcms.ru, +7 929 625-25-00. Website: https://bypcms.ru/. The customer is the person placing an order on the website.

The provider grants the right to use the proprietary part of BYPCMS within the paid edition, selected domain and module configuration. Exclusive rights to the software are not transferred. Third-party components remain subject to their own licenses.

sections.title: 2. Ordering and price
paragraphs: The price in rubles, edition, term, modules and domain are recorded in the order before payment. Modules included in an edition are not charged again. An order without confirmed payment grants no license rights. Only a confirmed order configuration may be paid for.

The customer separately accepts these terms and separately consents to data processing. The terms version and confirmation are recorded with the order. Creating an order is not payment. Payment for the agreed order constitutes acceptance of this offer for that purchase.

Services with starting prices are submitted as requests. Their scope, price, schedule, deliverables and acceptance procedure are agreed separately before payment. Such requests do not initiate an automatic charge.

The primary payment method is bank transfer against an invoice in the customer account. The invoice specifies the exact scope, total, payment deadline and seller's bank details. Starting service prices in the configurator are estimates and do not become payable amounts. Before paying for custom work, the customer accepts a specific invoice describing deliverables, timing and acceptance.

An additional method is payment against an invoice separately issued by the seller in YooKassa. Its link is added to the relevant order. Use one selected payment method; a second transfer is not required. Automatic payments, saved card billing and automatic subscription renewals are not used. Do not pay a canceled or expired invoice; request a new one.

sections.title: 3. License scope and duration
paragraphs: One license covers one website on the order's domain. It permits installation, operation and configuration of your BYPCMS copy, modification of its code for that website, and backups. Sharing the license key, reselling the license or using one key for independent websites is not permitted. Domain transfers require agreement with the provider and removal of the previous binding.

The annual plan includes delivery of the selected build and access to available compatible updates during the paid term. Expiry alone does not disable the public website or delete its data. Renewal is paid separately. Retrying a request does not add another paid period.

The lifetime plan has no set expiry date for update rights for the purchased edition and modules. It does not automatically include future separate paid products, custom development or unlimited support.

Demo screens and sample data illustrate interface possibilities. The actual release scope is specified in the purchase description. Additional work and external integrations are not included without a separate agreement.

sections.title: 4. Payment and delivery
paragraphs: The seller verifies bank transfers and YooKassa invoice payments against funds actually received in the bank statement or a successful result in YooKassa. The customer may provide a transaction reference; a screenshot, following a link or creating an invoice does not confirm payment. Reconciliation is normally completed within one business day after receipt. Partial or excess payments and transfers against canceled invoices are resolved separately with the customer; no license is issued before reconciliation.

After license payment is confirmed, the archive, key and instructions are available in the account order. If delivery is technically delayed, the seller completes it no later than the next business day or agrees a resolution or refund. The seller issues a professional income tax receipt through My Tax and provides it to the customer. An invoice, payment instruction or service email does not replace a receipt. Email failure does not cancel payment or close order access.

A services-only order does not issue a license. In a mixed order, license delivery fulfills only the license portion. Services are delivered and accepted separately under the agreed invoice's scope, schedule and procedure. Ongoing support is paid for the invoice period without automatic charges.

sections.title: 5. Support and use
paragraphs: Send delivery, activation and reproducible error inquiries to hello@bypcms.ru with the order number and a description. Server access or personal data should be shared only after separately agreeing a secure method.

The customer is responsible for compatible hosting, backups and the lawfulness of their content. Setup, migration, modifications and ongoing support are paid separately unless expressly included in the agreed order. These terms do not limit mandatory warranties or statutory rights.

sections.title: 6. Refunds and termination of rights
paragraphs: The customer may submit a request from a paid order or email hello@bypcms.ru. A request does not initiate a refund. The provider reviews the facts and grounds, gives a reasoned decision and, if agreed, confirms the refund amount. Downloading the software alone is not an automatic ground to refuse statutory claims.

A fully confirmed refund of the original purchase terminates the license rights granted by that order and access to downloads, new activation and updates. The customer must stop using and remove the relevant software copies, preserving their own data separately. The provider does not remotely delete the customer's website or data.

Refunding a renewal cancels the additional term paid by that order. Original rights and other paid periods are considered separately. For a partial refund, the parties agree whether rights remain as compensation or the relevant scope ends. The provider records the amount and effect on rights.

After the provider confirms submission of a refund, downloads and server license operations may be temporarily restricted pending its outcome. If the payment system definitively rejects the refund, the temporary restriction is removed. An unknown result must be reconciled before any repeated transfer. See Payment and refunds for the detailed procedure.

sections.title: 7. Inquiries and applicable law
paragraphs: An inquiry must identify the order and the customer's request. A response is sent within 10 calendar days after necessary information is received, unless applicable law requires a shorter period. Actual refund crediting depends on the payment system and the customer's bank.

Russian Federation law applies. These terms do not exclude mandatory consumer rights or impose an unconditional ban on refunds for digital purchases. Disputes should first be submitted to the provider using the listed contacts; statutory remedies remain available.

privacy.title: Personal data processing policy
privacy.lead: How BYPCMS uses data for registration, orders and support inquiries.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: Controller: Yury Petrovich Babachkov, Tax ID 550519989590, self-employed without individual entrepreneur status. For data processing, access, correction, withdrawal of consent or deletion requests: hello@bypcms.ru, +7 929 625-25-00. This policy applies to https://bypcms.ru/ and its customer account.

sections.title: 2. Data and purposes
paragraphs: Registration uses your name, email and a password hash. Orders use the installation domain, edition, configuration, term, amount and payment and delivery states. Phone, company and comments are optional. Support and refund requests retain the text, order number and review result.

Session operation and security use technical cookies, IP address, browser information, action times and document confirmation records. A checkout draft may be saved in this browser tab's sessionStorage. Passwords and complete bank card details are not stored in that draft.

Purposes include creating and protecting the account, placing and fulfilling orders, payment verification, license delivery and activation, updates, support and refund handling, document creation and legal obligations. Registration or purchase does not consent to advertising emails.

Payment and refund reconciliation retains the invoice number, exact amount, date, source, bank transaction identifier and owner's confirmation. Seller bank details are accessible to the relevant customer in their invoice and are not published in the public catalog.

sections.title: 3. Grounds and processing activities
paragraphs: Data is processed on the basis of separate consent, to conclude and perform a contract with the user, and to meet the controller's legal obligations. Activities include collection, recording, storage, correction, use, necessary disclosure to engaged providers, restriction and deletion.

Required fields are marked on forms. Additional information is voluntary. Do not include documents, passwords, card details or special categories of personal data unnecessary for the order in comments.

sections.title: 4. Disclosure and protection
paragraphs: For payment processing, necessary order information and email are sent to YooKassa (YooMoney NBCO LLC). Card details are entered with the payment provider and are also governed by its rules. Information needed for a professional income tax receipt may be sent to the Federal Tax Service through My Tax.

The website uses a hosting provider and a mail service selected by the controller. They receive data necessary for hosting, storage and service notifications under relevant service terms and processing instructions. The specific mail service is selected during SMTP configuration.

Access controls, secure connections, password hashing, encryption of stored secrets, logging and backups are used. Database location and service provider terms must comply with applicable requirements for processing Russian citizens' data. Changes to services and disclosure terms require this policy to be updated; requirements for an independent legal basis or disclosure consent remain.

sections.title: 5. Retention and your rights
paragraphs: Data is retained until processing purposes are met and for periods necessary to perform the contract, protect lawful interests and meet legal requirements. Once grounds cease, data is deleted or anonymized. Backups follow the controller's retention and restoration cycle. Records required for transaction accounting or legal compliance may remain after account deletion.

You may request information, correction, restriction or deletion and withdraw consent by emailing hello@bypcms.ru. To prevent unauthorized disclosure, the controller may verify the request's connection to the account or order without requesting excessive information.

Withdrawal does not cancel processing with an independent lawful basis or completed transactions. Requests and actions follow statutory deadlines. You retain the right to contact Roskomnadzor and the courts.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and changes
paragraphs: Sign-in uses necessary session cookies. They do not constitute consent to advertising or optional analytics. Additional analytics requiring consent must provide a separate user choice before activation.

The policy date and version are displayed on this page. The accepted version is recorded at checkout; document archives are linked here. Material changes to processing purposes require an appropriate basis, rather than merely replacing the policy text.

consent.title: Consent to personal data processing
consent.lead: A separate document confirmed in registration and checkout forms.

sections.title: Who receives consent
paragraphs: I consent to Yury Petrovich Babachkov, Tax ID 550519989590, processing the data I provide for registration and operation of my account, placing and fulfilling BYPCMS orders, license delivery and activation, service notifications, support and requests, including refunds.

sections.title: Data and processing activities
paragraphs: Consent covers name, email, voluntarily supplied phone, company and comments, domain and order details, support correspondence, technical session data, IP address, browser and document confirmation records. Passwords are stored as hashes; card details are entered with the payment provider.

I permit collection, recording, organization, storage, correction, use and necessary disclosure to hosting, mail and payment providers for these purposes, as well as restriction and deletion, with or without automation, in accordance with the privacy policy. This consent does not permit publication, advertising emails or sale of my data.

sections.title: Confirmation and withdrawal
paragraphs: Consent is expressed by a separate checkbox, unchecked by default, and submission of the relevant form. Purchase terms are accepted using another checkbox. The controller retains the time, document version and technical confirmation information.

Consent applies until the stated purposes are achieved or consent is withdrawn. Withdraw by emailing hello@bypcms.ru and identifying your account or order. Processing then stops as required by law, except for data and actions with an independent lawful basis. The privacy policy lists the controller's contacts and your rights.

refunds.title: Payment and refunds
refunds.lead: Payment verification, purchase delivery and the effect of refunds on your license.

sections.title: Payment and delivery
paragraphs: The primary method is bank transfer against an invoice in your account. An additional method is payment of a separately issued YooKassa invoice. The ruble total is recorded in the invoice before payment. Starting service prices must first be agreed with deliverables, schedule and acceptance. A services-only invoice does not automatically include a license.

The seller verifies actual funds received using the bank statement or YooKassa account. After license payment is confirmed, the archive and key appear in your account. Email failure does not cancel payment. Services follow the agreed invoice. A professional income tax receipt is issued separately through My Tax and provided to the customer.

sections.title: Requesting a refund
paragraphs: Submit a request from a paid order in your account or email hello@bypcms.ru. Include the order number, reason and requested resolution. Keep proof of payment. You do not need to provide a full card number, CVV or password.

A request does not automatically refund money or cancel the license. The owner reviews the circumstances, responds and, if agreed, confirms the amount and effect on rights. A response is sent within 10 calendar days after necessary information is received, unless the law requires a shorter period. Downloading does not remove statutory customer rights.

sections.title: Confirmation and result
paragraphs: Refunds are not issued automatically on request. After review and agreement, the seller separately returns funds through the bank or YooKassa, considering the original payment method, and records the completed operation, amount, date and effect on rights in the order. A BYPCMS record does not initiate a bank transfer. Confirming the same operation again does not create another refund.

Earlier YooKassa API payments retain server-side refund reconciliation. Unknown results require reconciliation before another financial operation. Confirmed payment and delivery failure are tracked separately.

A successful full refund of the original purchase terminates that license's rights and closes repeat downloads, activation and updates. Downloaded files are not remotely destroyed. The customer must stop using the copy under the purchase terms. The customer's website and data are not remotely deleted.

Refunding a renewal cancels the relevant additional period while accounting for other paid periods. If the term was manually changed and automatic reconciliation is impossible, the owner separately confirms the correct remaining term. Partial compensation may preserve rights only by explicit agreement; the owner records the effect on rights.

For invoice payments, the owner records a completed refund after checking the bank or YooKassa. A full refund terminates the corresponding paid rights. A partial refund's effect on the license is separately agreed and recorded. The seller adjusts the My Tax receipt and provides the information to the customer.

The payment system and bank credit the refund to the original payment method where supported. The order shows its status and amount. This procedure does not exclude mandatory rights or remedies under Russian Federation law.
